data.name: Vibhashree
data.gender_notes: Vibhashree is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vibh' meaning 'Knowledge' and 'Asht' meaning 'Eight'. It represents the ability to discern truth from falsehood and is a symbol of wisdom and knowledge. The name Vibhashree carries the meaning “Knowledge, Discrimination” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vibhashree usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, discrimination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the quest for knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Vibhashree belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Discrimination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vibhashree total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Vibhashree" highlights the importance of knowledge and discernment in Hindu culture. In various parts of India, there are tales and traditions revolving around the pursuit of knowledge and the enlightenment that it brings. This name carries the legacy of these values, reminding us of the significance of education, self-growth, and intellectual curiosity.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, "Vibhashree" embodies the divine qualities of wisdom and discernment. In Hindu scriptures, Vibhuti, an auspicious form of Lord Shiva, is described as having the powers of wisdom and knowledge. This name is a reminder that one must strive to attain inner wisdom and knowledge by seeking the truth and casting away ignorance. In this way, the name inspires individuals to embark on a spiritual journey towards enlightenment and self-realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vibhasthree: Radiating harmony and transformation, Vibhasthree embodies the divine balance between inner peace and outer growth. Her name in Sanskrit signifies "the one who bestows auspicious blessings" and "remover of obstacles", inspiring self-confidence and inner strength.

vedic_reference.note: Vibhashree is a beautiful Sanskrit name with the meaning of 'Differentiator of Truth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vibhava' which means 'Differentiator' and 'Shree' which is a name of the Goddess of Fortune. This name signifies that the person named Vibhashree is a truthful administrator who can differentiate between right and wrong. In Hinduism, the Goddess Shree is revered as the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. The name Vibhashree is a perfect blend of these two meanings and is a beautiful name for a baby girl.

historical_references.reference: Vibhatsa was a great king who ruled over the kingdom of Anga during the 5th century BCE. His daughter, Vibhashree, is famously known for her beauty and wisdom.

Vibhashree was a renowned Tamil poetess and a disciple of the great Tamil poet, Thiruvalluvar, who lived during the 1st century BCE. She is celebrated for her poetic works, particularly on love and spirituality.
